title: TaskEvent
description: The single build/CI event contract for the polyglot-demo stack. Owned by py-worker; go-service, rust-service, and web all reference this file.

topic.description: Must be one of the canonical topics in topics.json.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

payload.description: Free-form event payload; consumers must tolerate unknown keys.
